nombreAyuda: It's the name your contributions appear under. {email} isn't shown anywhere.
aliasAyuda: It's the only name shown in {colaboradores}, the public monthly table.
aliasConAlias: Delete it and you stop being listed; your contributions still count.
aliasSinAlias: Without an alias you're not listed, and your name isn't published anywhere.
favoritasAyuda: They decide which three beers show first at each bar.
vibracionAyuda: A short buzz when you vote, confirm a price or mark a favorite.
sonidoAyuda: The same, with a short tone. On iPhone it's the only one of the two that works.
monedaAyuda: The one for bars you add by hand. If you pick the bar from the search, the currency comes from the country and this isn't used. Prices are always shown in the bar's currency: nothing is converted.
vasoAyuda: Which size the price keypad starts with. A pint is 473 ml in Argentina and the US, and 568 in the UK.
radioAyuda: How far around you the map and list open.
bloqueadasAyuda: With someone blocked, neither of you sees the other's comments or photos. The prices they added stay on the map: they're data about bars.
borrar1: Your account, your reviews and your session are deleted. It can't be undone.
borrar2: The prices you added stay on the map, but without your name: they're data about bars, not about you, and deleting them would leave everyone worse informed.
